rows.title_full: AN ACT ABOLISHING THE PENALTIES CHARGED BY DEPOSITORY BANKS AGAINST DEPOSITS THAT FALL BELOW THE PRESCRIBED AVERAGE DAILY BALANCE
rows.abstract: Rationale: The Supereme Court, in Tian Tiong Tick vs. American Apothecaries, rules that deposits of money in banks whether fixed, savings and current are really loans to a bank because the bank can use the same for its ordinary transactions and forthe banking business in which it is engaged. In the interest of justice and fair play, it is therefore just and proper to abolish such irrational charges.  For, banks are regarded as borrowers under the law because Supreme Court decisions form part of the law of the land.

rows.title_full: AN ACT EXEMPTING A MUNICIPALITY FROM THE ADDITIONAL REQUISITE ON LAND AREA OR POPULATION FOR ITS CONVERSION INTO A CITY PROVIDED ITS AVERAGE ANNUAL INCOME IS AT LEAST P200 MILLION, AMENDING SEC. 450 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991 AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Rationale:  As provided, a municipality who aims to be converted into a city, may be exempted from the additional requisites of land are or population if such municipality has reached an income of at least P200 Million or ten times than that prescribed under the Local Government Code.  This amendment should give each and every municipality to strive and obtain the peak of autonomy in local governance through cityhood regardless of its size and population.

rows.author: B007
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING PROTECTION AND SUPPORT TO STUDENT COUNCILS IN SCHOOL CAMPUSES
rows.abstract: "Student Council Act of 2000." Rationale: Indeed, the existence of student councils in the country today is a tribute to the hundred of student leaders who braved the odds to realize their vision of forming an organization that would protect their rights and welfare. Without ample support or assistance from the State, these student activists took it upon themselves to claim what is justily due them.  This piece of legislation, therefore, seeks to correct this decades-long injustice done to students and, at the same time, and lay the legal framework for the institutionaliz ation of autonomous, representative and democratic student councils in school campuses.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2000-07-17
